text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: SVC-SYNTH-CANARY — multiple synthetic checks failing across regions (eu-west1, us-east1). Threshold: 6 failures in 3m. Probe: canary-liveness-v2. Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC12345

pagerduty: Alert details: SVC-SYNTH-CANARY · fired · triggered by synthetic-monitoring · severity: P2 · runbook: synth-canary-triage. Escalation policy: oncall-sre.

alex: Acked in PD, I'm oncall and will triage. tagging @mica for infra-side check. Starting with dashboards + canary logs.

mica: seeing error spikes in synthetic metrics and a duplicated probe count in the monitoring cluster. UI shows ~2x expected probe executions in last 10m in both eu & us regions. Correlating with deploys?

alex: good catch. No control plane deploys in last 30m per deploy-bot, but there was a monitoring-agent image bump 20m ago.

pri: I grabbed the agent rollout timeline — monitoring-agent v4.2.1 rolled to 60% at 17:42 UTC, then auto-rollback attempted. Might be related.

alex: runbook step 1: validate probe flooding. Running probe counts and a quick curl to health endpoints.

alex: ```bash
# check recent probe executions (monitoring cluster)
kubectl -n monitoring logs deploy/synth-agent --since=30m | grep canary-liveness | wc -l
# sample probe log
kubectl -n monitoring logs deploy/synth-agent -c probe | tail -n 50 | grep canary-liveness
```

mica: results: counts are ~2x normal. Logs show duplicated schedule events and concurrent workers spawning due to missing leader-election lock. Error pattern: "failed to acquire leader lock, spawning fallback worker" repeated.

alex: that would double-probe and overload a small subset of backend endpoints, can push error rates up and trigger PD. Mitigation: disable aggressive rollout and scale down synth-agent replicas to 1 in monitoring cluster.

jamie: I'll scale replicas to 1 now in eu-west1 and us-east1 monitoring namespaces. Command: `kubectl -n monitoring scale deploy/synth-agent --replicas=1`

jamie: scaled eu-west1 -> replicas=1. Waiting for stabilization.

jamie: scaled us-east1 -> replicas=1. Observing probe counts drop.

mica: counts dropping. Synthetic failures also trending down. Hosted API 5xx rate falls back to baseline within 90s.

pagerduty: Alert updated: customer impact reduced — synthetic alerts decreasing, auto-escalation halted.

alex: Good. Next: disable the v4.2.1 rollout and pin to v4.2.0 until root cause confirmed. pri, can you abort the canary rollout and create a mitigation PR?

pri: on it — opened PR #4823 to pin agent image to v4.2.0 and added rollback-note. Also notified dev on-call for agent.

status-page-bot: Status page draft created: "Investigating: Intermittent synthetic check failures affecting canary monitors in multiple regions. Some internal customers saw elevated 5xx rates briefly. Mitigation underway." Approve to publish?

alex: publish the draft with note that mitigation in progress. Keep message concise.

status-page-bot: Published. Incident subscribers notified.

jamie: systems look stable for 6m. No further spikes. I'll leave replica=1 until we have confirmed leader-election fix.

mica: monitoring-agent logs show leader-election config missing the lease-duration override introduced in v4.2.1 — PR from agent author changed defaults, causing dual-scheduler fallback behavior during rollout.

alex: root cause hypothesis: v4.2.1 introduced a leader-election config change; during gradual rollout, some pods had old behavior and some new causing duplicate scheduling in failover. That doubled probe traffic and surfaced backend flakiness.

pri: dev team is reverting the default in a patch branch. They estimate a 2hr fix+canary. We'll keep pinned to v4.2.0 in prod.

alex: Action items: 1) Keep replicas=1 in monitoring clusters until patch deployed and validated (assigned jamie). 2) Postmortem after incident (assigned alex + pri). 3) Add automated canary detection for duplicate probe counts (assigned mica).

jamie: handing off oncall to pri (now). Pri, please take over live monitoring.

pri: Ack takeover. I'll keep eyes on the dashboard and follow up with dev for full revert.

alex: Thanks team. Final update: synthetic alerts cleared, customer metric impact short-lived, mitigated by scaling and rollback pin. We'll run postmortem and retro. Closing PD incident after follow-ups. :white_check_mark:

status-page-bot: Update published: "Mitigation: Duplicate probe executions were throttled by adjusting monitoring-agent replicas and pinning agent image. Root cause: leader-election config change in monitoring-agent v4.2.1. Next steps: full revert and postmortem."

pri: Will schedule postmortem and include timeline + runbook gaps. I'll drop details in #postmortems once ready.

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident INC12345 acknowledged and resolved by alex.

alex: closing thread — reach out if any regression. :wave:
